construction: Declared native phase-matched allocation of rounded paper active stat budgets; these are not exact paper snapshots or simulated recruit histories.

Bubble is the unique biggest Ooze. Native Bubble, Moss and Posset text remains authoritative; every fight starts before Start of Combat.
